title: Tisseur - Location, Weakness & How to Start the Fight
description: Tisseur in Expedition 33 is a non-hostile boss in Sirene that only fights you if you talk to it. Location, weakness (Fire/Light) and what to expect.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Tisseur is a large creation that, according to Verso, works for Sirene - endlessly producing fabric for her. It is an optional boss found in the Sirene area.

The unusual part: Tisseur is not hostile on sight. You can walk past it. The fight only begins if you initiate a conversation, which then prompts combat.

sections.title: Where to Find Tisseur
sections.content:
Location: Sirene.

Approach and interact with it to start the encounter. If you are not ready for the fight, you can simply not talk to it.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire, Light
ResistsIce, Dark, Earth

Fire and Light are both effective; Ice, Dark and Earth are all resisted and should be avoided.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: Tisseur's specific drop list is not documented in the sources we could verify. We would rather leave this blank than guess.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.content:
Because it resists three elements and is weak to two, this is a build-check fight similar to the elemental Eveque variants - arriving with the wrong damage type makes it significantly harder than it needs to be.

Since you choose when to start it, use that: check your element coverage first, then start the conversation.
